SRAF / SUPER DESTROYER COMMAND / CHIME FOUNDATION P5

Four directions, four electronic personalities

One new original palette. All four chimes await listening approval. Your approved original UP/DOWN and every earlier candidate remain unchanged.

Expressive, friendly nonverbal communication reinterpreted as a Super Destroyer interface. Superintendent/Vergil is the stylistic reference. These are newly synthesized sounds, with no Halo samples, melodies, voice or extracted assets.

Each input triggers one compact, continuous 110 ms chime. Internal partials and movement share one envelope. There are no separate accent notes, double beeps or echoes.

All audio is embedded for offline playback. Start at a comfortable listening volume and leave it unchanged for comparison. New sounds have matched short-event frequency-weighted energy; this is a loudness comparison aid, not integrated LUFS or proof of equal perceived loudness.

1. Individual directions

UP · Lifting bell: clean, bright and lightly ringing

DOWN · Rounded settle: soft swelling onset and a low, warm bend

LEFT · Hollow liquid chirp: rounded articulation and a changing odd-harmonic colour

RIGHT · Metallic snap: immediate attack with a dry, lightly inharmonic ring
